Welcome to Mundo

A whole world of care, right here in Fort Mill

Mundo means “world” in Spanish. Since 2015 our privately owned, non-corporate office has been built on one idea: everyone who walks in should feel comfortable, cared for and understood, in English or Spanish.

  • Bilingual team: English and español
  • Beverage bar and a TV in every room
  • We do it all, so you need fewer referrals
Get to Know Us

Advanced Technology

Fewer visits, more precise care

Same-Day Crowns

CEREC lets us design, mill and place a porcelain crown in a single visit. No temporary, no second appointment.

3D CBCT Imaging

A 3D cone-beam scan shows bone, nerves and sinuses, so treatment like implants is planned precisely before it starts.

Guided Implants

In-house guided implant technology turns that 3D plan into a precise placement, here in our Fort Mill office.

Book Online Our Technology

Complete care for every smile in the family

From a child's first checkup to braces, implants and same-day crowns, more than 25 services happen under one roof, so you're not sent across town for the next step.

Dental Implants

Replace one tooth or a full arch with implants planned on a 3D CBCT scan and placed right here in our Fort Mill office.

Learn more

Braces & Invisalign

Orthodontics for teens and adults under the same roof as your dentist: traditional braces or clear aligners.

Learn more

Family & Preventive Care

Checkups, cleanings and care for kids and grown-ups, with low-radiation digital X-rays and fluoride when it helps.
